“呃，什么情况，主动投怀送抱竟然还害羞？”
陈阳心里嘟哝，在没有弄清楚情况之前，他可不想乱来，因为他从来不会强迫女人。
双手从哥特女孩背上抬起，可突然女孩似乎受到了惊吓，速度极快地抓住了陈阳的手腕，然后将他的手按在了自己的后背。
陈阳皱了下眉头，这到底什么情况，欲拒还迎？
就在这时，三名穿着黑西装的壮汉出现在酒吧门口，一进来就四处张望，明显是在寻找着什么？
很快，三名壮汉看向了陈阳这边，目光落在了他怀里少女的身上，朝着这边走了过来。
我靠，搞了半天是想拿我当挡箭牌。
明白过来，陈阳顿时就不乐意了，他可从来没有被别人利用的习惯。
“既然如此，那我就不客气了。”
心里嘿嘿一笑，陈阳双手用力把女孩搂了下。
女孩身躯一颤，一道冷冰冰的声音从陈阳怀里传来：“别乱动，否则你会后悔的。”
见对方竟然威胁自己，陈阳嘴角勾起一抹坏笑，你不让我动，我还偏要动。
女孩只觉后颈一凉，反应过来，原来是陈阳吹了口气。
她像是受到了惊吓，身子猛地往前一蹿，想要躲闪，却和陈阳抱得更紧，两人的脸几乎是贴在了一起。
三名朝这边走过来的壮汉见此，先是面面相觑，随即都认为以自家小姐的性格，绝不可能让男人抱得这么紧，这个女人只是背影和小姐有些像而已。
三名壮汉转移了方向，在酒吧里搜索了一圈后，离开了酒吧。
“怎么走了，不是来抓人吗？”
陈阳心里嘟哝了一句，怀里的哥特女孩猛地退开，近距离下，他发现女孩的脸已经红透到了脖子根，显然是害羞到了极点，但却极力掩饰住，歪着脑袋瞪着他，恶狠狠道：“小子，你刚才竟然敢摸我？！”
陈阳指了指酒吧门口，一脸无辜道：“我见有人在找你，为了掩饰，这才假装和你是情侣的。可是没想到我帮了你，你居然还责怪我，真是没天理。”
见陈阳一脸委屈，哥特女孩愣了下，有些不好意思起来。可是她聂伊辰从小到大，还从来没被男人这样抱过，难道就这样算了？

聂伊辰想了想，对方的确帮了自己，不然被抓回去的话，今天和别人约好的事情，肯定就只能爽约，到时候还不得被圈子里的人狠狠鄙视一番。
但身子不能被白碰，怎么也得让他付出点代价才行。
聂伊辰心里主意一定，拍了拍陈阳的肩膀，豪爽道：“兄弟，江湖救急，我理解，刚才谢了。”
陈阳见聂伊辰一副江湖好汉的模样，心里觉得好笑，但表面上却一本正经地配合道：“哪里的话，路见不平拔刀相助，正是我辈应该做的事情。”
“作为答谢，我决定带你去一个地方。”
聂伊辰认真道，可是眼中闪过的一丝狡黠却出卖了她。
明知对方有诈，陈阳却丝毫不在意，故作好奇道：“好呀，什么地方？”
“去了你就知道了。”聂伊辰见陈阳上钩，笑了笑，带着陈阳离开了酒吧。
酒吧后一个隐蔽的小巷道，聂伊辰在一辆看起来十分破旧的白色老捷达前停下了脚步，指着车对陈阳道：“作为答谢，我决定让你见识一下我的车，以及我的车技。”
一听这话，陈阳皱了下眉头，搓着双手道：“这样不好吧，我们才刚刚认识就……”
“别磨磨唧唧的，是男人就上车。”聂伊辰一边说着，陈阳，所有的舒适型配置都已经拆除，只留下了前排两个赛车座椅，以及方向盘、变速箱等驾驶必要的组件，另外像涡轮表、防滚架这些也都有。
对于这辆改装车，陈阳有些意外，但他并没有表现出来。
他在赛车座椅上坐下，一边脱自己身上的衣服，一边朝着车内四处望了望，对聂伊辰道：“这车这么挤，座椅又不能动，有些不好施展呀。”
聂伊辰看着把T恤下摆拉起来的陈阳，嘴角一抽，艳红的嘴唇有些打颤，问道：“你……你干什么？”
“你不是说让我见识你的车技吗，来吧。”陈阳挑了挑眉毛，说着继续脱自己的衣服。

content_en:
"Uh, what's going on, you're so shy about throwing yourself into someone's arms?"
Chen Yang muttered in his heart that he didn't want to mess around before he figured out the situation, because he would never force a woman.
He raised his hands from the Goth girl's back, but suddenly the girl seemed to be frightened. She grabbed Chen Yang's wrist very quickly, and then pressed his hand on her back.
Chen Yang frowned. What on earth is going on? He wants to refuse but still welcomes him?
At this moment, three strong men in black suits appeared at the door of the bar. They looked around as soon as they entered, obviously looking for something?
Soon, the three strong men looked towards Chen Yang, their eyes fell on the girl in his arms, and they walked towards this side.
Damn it, you’ve been doing this for a long time just to use me as a shield.
After realizing this, Chen Yang was immediately unhappy. He had never been in the habit of being taken advantage of by others.
"In that case, I won't be polite."
With a chuckle in his heart, Chen Yang hugged the girl hard with both hands.
The girl's body trembled, and a cold voice came from Chen Yang's arms: "Don't move, otherwise you will regret it."
Seeing that the other party was actually threatening him, Chen Yang raised a smirk on his lips, "You won't let me move, but I still want to move."
The girl felt a chill on the back of her neck, and when she realized it, it was Chen Yang who blew the air.
She seemed to be frightened, and she jumped forward suddenly, trying to dodge, but she hugged Chen Yang tighter, and their faces were almost touching each other.
When the three strong men walking over saw this, they looked at each other in confusion at first, and then they all thought that with the character of their young lady, it would be impossible for a man to hug her so tightly. This woman only had a slight resemblance to her from the back.
The three strong men changed direction and left the bar after searching around the bar.
"Why are you leaving? Aren't you here to arrest someone?"
Chen Yang muttered in his heart, and the Goth girl in his arms suddenly stepped away. From a close distance, he found that the girl's face was already red to the root of her neck. She was obviously extremely shy, but she tried her best to hide it. She tilted her head and glared at him, and said viciously: "Boy, how dare you touch me just now?!"
Chen Yang pointed to the door of the bar and said with an innocent face: "I saw someone looking for you, so in order to cover up, I pretended to be a couple with you. But I didn't expect you to blame me after I helped you. It's really unreasonable."
Seeing Chen Yang's aggrieved face, the Goth girl was stunned for a moment and felt a little embarrassed. But she, Nie Yichen, had never been hugged like this by a man since she was a child. Could this be the end of it?
Nie Yichen thought for a while and realized that the other party had indeed helped him. Otherwise, if he were caught, he would definitely have to break the appointment with someone else today, and he would not be able to be severely despised by the people in the circle.
But his body couldn't be touched in vain, he had to pay some price no matter what.
Nie Yichen made up his mind, patted Chen Yang on the shoulder, and said boldly: "Brother, Jianghu is here to help. I understand, thank you just now."
Seeing Nie Yichen's heroic appearance, Chen Yang felt funny in his heart, but on the surface he cooperated in a serious manner: "If there is any situation, drawing a sword to help when the road is rough is exactly what we should do."
"As a thank you, I decided to take you somewhere."
Nie Yichen said seriously, but the cunning flash in his eyes gave her away.
Knowing that the other party was cheating, Chen Yang didn't care at all and pretended to be curious: "Okay, where?"
"You'll know when you get there." Nie Yichen saw that Chen Yang took the bait, smiled, and left the bar with Chen Yang.
In a hidden alleyway behind the bar, Nie Yichen stopped in front of an old white Jetta that looked very shabby. He pointed at the car and said to Chen Yang, "As a thank you, I decided to let you see my car and my driving skills."
Upon hearing this, Chen Yang frowned, rubbed his hands and said, "Isn't this bad? We just met..."
"Stop whining, it's a manPeople get on the bus. "Nie Yichen said, "Chen Yang, all the comfort configurations have been removed, leaving only the two front racing seats, as well as the steering wheel, gearbox and other necessary components for driving, as well as turbine meters and roll cages.
Chen Yang was a little surprised about this modified car, but he didn't show it.
He sat down on the racing seat, took off his clothes, looked around the car, and said to Nie Yichen: "This car is so crowded, and the seats can't move, so it's a bit difficult to use. "
Nie Yichen looked at Chen Yang who was pulling up the hem of his T-shirt, twitched the corners of his mouth, his bright red lips trembled a little, and asked: "You...what are you doing? "
"Didn't you say you would let me see your driving skills? Come on. "Chen Yang raised his eyebrows and continued to take off his clothes.
